manifiesto.title: The day ends watching the sunset over the water.
manifiesto.body: La Casa del Lago is wood and brick cabins by the still water of the Urugua-í. Days of the dock, kayaking and the pool; nights of fire, asado and open sky. We bring the calm.

experiencias.title: The lake, unhurried.
experiencias.body: A private dock, kayaks and sunsets reflected on the water. And once the sun goes down, fire: a wood stove inside, an asado outside.

nature.title: The water
nature.desc: Dock, kayak, fishing and a turquoise pool facing the lake.

gastronomy.title: Sunsets
gastronomy.desc: The golden sky over the still water, every single day.

frontier.title: Fire and asado
frontier.desc: Grill, bonfire and wood stove: the warmth of the inside.

activities.title: Misiones jungle
activities.desc: Palm trees, trails and carpets of autumn leaves.

relato.intro: A walk through La Casa del Lago in photos: from the first reflection on the water to the last thoughtfully chosen corner.

llegada.c: Cross the garden and the turquoise water is already waiting.

descenso.c: A few steps among autumn maples and you're at the pool's edge.

agua.c: Sunlight scattered over the warm coping: the midday pause.

refugio.c: The cabin peeks out among the palms, level with the water.

selva.c: Orchids on the trunk and open sky between the leaves.

iris.c: Flowers that open with the morning dew.

heliconia.c: The tropical red that grows in the damp.

adentro.c: Objects chosen with care for every room.

descanso.c: En-suite bathrooms with fine materials and soft light.

rincon.c: Nothing left to chance, down to the last artwork.

footer.tagline: Cabins on the shores of Lake Urugua-í. Disconnection, sunsets and fire in Puerto Libertad, Misiones.

departamento.subtitle: Design, comfort and first-class amenities, on the shores of Lake Urugua-í.

spaceBody.timbo: Wood and brick facing the lake: two bedrooms, a covered deck with a grill and a deck where the day ends watching the sunset over the water. The Timbó is the roomiest cabin in the house, with a full kitchen, a wood stove for cool nights and direct access to the dock and the pool — perfect for families or two couples who want to disconnect without giving up comfort.
spaceBody.lapacho: A bright cabin: 1 bedroom, a full bathroom, an equipped kitchen, living and dining rooms. With pool access, on the shores of Lake Urugua-í, between Iguazú and Libertad.
spaceBody.guatambu: A cabin with everything you need: 2 bedrooms, a full bathroom, a fully equipped kitchen and a laundry room with washer. With pool access, on the shores of Lake Urugua-í, between Iguazú and Libertad.
